name: Teen DJ Academy
org: The Andy Warhol Museum with Tech25
what_you_do: Learn to DJ in a free 12-week workshop led by professional DJs. You use pro gear, make your own mixes and perform live at events like Youth Invasion and the LGBTQ+ Prom.
who_can_apply: Teens ages 14 to 18 who commit to at least 9 workshops. Space is limited. (The Tech25 page says 13 to 18; the Warhol page says 14 to 18, so ask if you are 13.)
pay_detail: Free to join. Teens get a stipend for workshop sessions plus extra stipends for each performance. Amounts are not stated.
duration: 12 weeks, Mondays 4 to 6 pm (Print Lounge in The Pop District)
deadline_text: The Warhol page says applications are now closed. Next dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: Applications are closed. Watch the Warhol teens page and the Tech25 page for the next round. Questions: teens@warhol.org.
notes: The Warhol teens page says applications are closed. The Tech25 page says 'apply now!' but gives no dates, so ask Warhol before assuming it is open. The Warhol teens page also lists paid Student Assistant jobs at the museum (no ages or dates stated; email teens@warhol.org or see Carnegie Museums careers). Workshops are funded by the Richard King Mellon Foundation and the Henry L. Hillman Foundation.
